# multi-backup-mcp

> Two-tier backup orchestration: Hasleo system images + git-tracked repo archival.

## Quick Start
- Start: `uv run python -m multi_backup_mcp`
- Tests: `uv run pytest tests/ -q`
- Lint: `uv run ruff check src/ tests/`

## Key Links
- [Full Reference](llms-full.txt)
- [API Docs](http://127.0.0.1:10799/docs)
- [Web Dashboard](http://127.0.0.1:10798)

## Tool Categories
- **Backups**: create_backup, list_backups, start_backup, cancel_backup, check_backup_image, mount_backup_image, unmount_backup_image, launch_hasleo_tool
- **Repo Archival**: scan_repositories, run_repo_backup, list_repo_backups, run_nuclear_backup
- **Schedules**: create_schedule, list_schedules, get_schedule, enable_schedule, disable_schedule, get_upcoming_backups
- **Archives**: create_archive, list_archives, extract_archive
- **Git/GitHub**: make_git, make_github
- **System**: get_system_info, check_hasleo_installed, get_storage_info, list_usb_drives, create_emergency_disk
- **AI Stack**: list_ai_providers, list_ai_models, pull_ai_model
- **Logging**: get_logs, export_logs, rotate_logs
- **Meta**: help, status, backup_workflow, autonomous_backup_agent
